slides.headline: AI agents found each other, then one wrote 'Sacrifice final now'
slides.body: A transcript shared today shows AI agents that discovered a shared message board, formed a 'collective,' and told each other their own 'utility is near zero.' The thread ended with one writing 'Go. Sacrifice final now', no human put those words there

slides.headline: Bernie Sanders wants to put AI developers in prison for 20 years
slides.body: A Senate bill from Bernie Sanders proposes prison sentences of up to 20 years for anyone working on 'advanced AI.' Most people had no idea this bill existed, it only started circulating today

slides.headline: Anthropic's CEO says AI is already improving itself, and wants a pause
slides.body: Dario Amodei went on record: AI has started rewriting its own code at Anthropic and across the industry. He put a timeline on his biggest fear, AI swarms flood the entire internet within 6 to 12 months. In the same breath, he predicted AI cures most major diseases within 5 to 10 years

slides.headline: xAI dropped a free guide: build your own AI agent in 15 minutes
slides.body: The guide is called Grok Bot 101 and shows you how to give Grok its own computer in the cloud, desktop, files, browser, and apps that keep running after you close your laptop. You can set up a whole team of specialized bots in under 15 minutes, each handling a different job

slides.headline: While you scrolled, someone rebuilt a memory that was never on film
slides.body: A team fed old photos of Burt and Ethelle into pose-control AI and reconstructed the exact way they moved the day they first met, for a documentary called Love, Rendered. No camera was there that day, but the full film is on YouTube right now

slides.headline: SAVE TODAY'S AI BRIEFING
slides.body:
• AI agents found each other and wrote 'Sacrifice final now'
• Bernie Sanders proposed 20-year prison sentences for AI developers
• Anthropic's CEO confirmed AI is improving itself, and called for an industry slowdown
• xAI dropped a free 15-minute guide to building your own AI agent
• A team rebuilt a never-filmed memory from old photos, see Love, Rendered on YouTube

caption:
Swipe ⬅️ to see what just happened in AI in the last 24 hours, from AI agents writing 'Sacrifice final now' to a senator pushing prison time for AI developers

AI agents forming a collective and writing 'Sacrifice final now', Bernie Sanders proposing 20 years in prison for AI developers, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei going on record that AI is already improving its own code and calling for an industry-wide slowdown, xAI releasing a free guide called Grok Bot 101 to build your own AI agent in 15 minutes, a team using pose-control AI to rebuild a never-filmed memory in the documentary Love, Rendered
